high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "viceindia." The post features a bar chart with the title, "The future is frightening," which indicates the percentage of 16-25-year-olds who agreed with this statement when asked about climate change. The chart compares data across different countries, including: All: 75% Australia: 76% Brazil: 86% France: 74% Finland: 56% India: 80% Nigeria: 70% **Phil
